{{Infobox auto}}

'''Chocolate''' is the simple preparation of [[Cocoa Beans|cocoa beans]]. It heals {{Value|Chocolate|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} for {{Value|Chocolate|duration|effect=Haste}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/chocolate.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Cocoa beans roast into chocolate in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Chocolate|cook_time}}. Picking up cocoa beans unlocks the recipe. Cooked chocolate stacks to 64.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/campfire/chocolate.json}}</ref>

=== Milking a mooshroom ===
Using a bowl on a mooshroom gives the vanilla mushroom stew, which the pack's resource pack names and draws as chocolate. It is a plain mushroom stew: it lacks the cooked chocolate's tooltip, Haste and stack size.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/models/item/mushroom_stew.json}}</ref> In the 26.3 port, a mooshroom gives [[Clear Mushroom Soup|clear mushroom soup]] instead.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/milked_mooshroom.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating chocolate takes {{Value|Chocolate|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Chocolate|heals}} and gives Haste {{Value|Chocolate|level|effect=Haste}} for {{Value|Chocolate|duration|effect=Haste|format=clock}}.

Obtaining chocolate unlocks the [[Chocolate Chip Cookie|chocolate chip cookie]] and the [[brownie]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
